text.source: Results: NYC Board of Elections unofficial election-night results (enr.boenyc.gov, as of 12:42 a.m. EST Nov 4, 2026; scanners reporting by district range from about 81% to 99%), summed by State Assembly district. Hochul includes the Democratic and Working Families lines; Blakeman includes the Republican, Conservative and Vote Affordable lines; write-ins are left out. Hexagon weight is votes cast for the two candidates, not residents, because Assembly districts are drawn at near-equal population. District lines: NYS ITS Geospatial Services, 2022 Assembly districts, clipped to the shoreline. Swing compares with the official 2022 governor results by Assembly district from the NYC Board of Elections certified election-district report, summed across ballot lines and tied to the New York State Board of Elections county totals (two-party share). The 2022 and 2026 Assembly districts use the same 2022 lines.
